projectState.summary: Byte 11c-c has been approved, merged to main, and pushed. Byte 11d is implemented on `codex/byte-11d` and ready for review: melody and bass now each have a slow-thinking controller, the evaluator keeps only one slow-thinking request pending globally, bass's first opportunity is staggered, active slow-thought playback uses a per-player map, and bass is restricted to rest/thin-style actions. Debug APIs now expose `getSlowLoop(playerId?)`, `getSlowLoops()`, `getSlowPlayback(playerId?)`, and `getSlowPlaybacks()`. Validation: `npm audit`, `npm run build`, targeted smoke `npm run smoke -- -g "independent melody and bass"`, full `npm run smoke` 16/16, and `git diff --check` pass.
